verdict.rationale: Snyk documents an official local MCP server (Snyk MCP Server, part of Snyk Studio) that agents can connect to for security scanning, corroborated by a probe confirming the official docs page, and usage examples like prompting coding agents with natural language and running /snyk-fix commands in the agent. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party validation of the MCP server working reliably, and more detail on setup/configuration beyond docs snippets.
